events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 28 years since the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur. His music and message continue to resonate, cementing his status as a hip-hop icon.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: An Iconic Loss
events.blurb: The music world remembers Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27, leaving behind an unparalleled legacy as one of rock's most influential guitarists.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Walk this way! 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' and that unforgettable album cover. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring us all with The Pretenders' incredible music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and successful solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! 54 years young and still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, and it became available for purchase on November 10, 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the first iPod was announced? It truly changed the game for music lovers everywhere. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the 1962 world premiere of 'Dr. No', the very first 007 film.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of The Beatles' legendary songwriter and musician, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968, and in the US on November 25, 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Sounds
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a double LP packed with diverse and experimental tracks. Which one's your favourite deep cut?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991, aged 45.

angles.name: Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to captivate. His legacy truly lives on.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Evolution of Sound
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and showcased their incredible evolution. What's your top track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, who died on this day in 1980, aged 40.

angles.name: A Life Remembered
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose impact on music and culture remains immeasurable.
